coverage.Programming: holdout loss change on code-bearing material
coverage.Knowledge: retrieval hit rate against records held in the store
coverage.Reasoning: holdout loss change on inferential material
coverage.Memory: whether recallable material survives reopening the store
coverage.Learning: holdout loss change across recorded cycles
coverage.Stability: measured regression on the reserved document
coverage.Frustration: how often material defeated a bounded update (Architecture 21)
coverage.Expansion: whether an approved capacity growth lowered holdout loss

language.generated_from: the reserved document, which is held out of training
language.note: a high rate means the output is looping, which is the failure a loss number hides. It says nothing about whether the text is correct, meaningful, or an answer to anything; it is a floor on quality and the generated text is written beside this report so the number can be checked.

programming.note: no comparable before/after losses on programming material; 23 of 116 recorded sources look like it

reasoning.note: no comparable before/after losses on reasoning material; 20 of 116 recorded sources look like it

knowledge.note: a hit means the lexical matcher found the record it was built from. It does not mean the answer was right.

memory.note: counts read back from a store that was reopened, which is what a later session sees

stability.note: a positive percentage means the reserved document got better and a negative one means it got worse, both relative to the loss it started that cycle at. The regression rate is the share of measured cycles on which it got worse at all.

conflicts.note: a concept listed here is one that another source has been recorded as contradicting. It is direct evidence of conflicting knowledge rather than an inference from how often a bounded update failed.

frustration.note: Frustration is a measurement, not a diagnosis. It says how often material defeated a bounded update, which Architecture 21 uses to separate not knowing something from being unable to represent it. Only the second is a reason to expand.

expansion.note: the growth was authorised without a baseline loss, so it cannot be judged; approve one with the holdout loss to make it measurable

relationships.note: a type listed as unused is one the code can name and no run has ever created. It is reported rather than hidden, because the gap between the declared vocabulary and the recorded evidence is the honest state of this part of the system.

failures.question: What does a database index do?
What is the difference between a list and a set?
What does a comment in code do?
What is an error message for?

conversation.note: a reply passes when it contains the distinctive terms of the answer that followed this question in the material it was learned from. This measures whether what was learned can be recalled in the form it was learned in. It is a retrieval-shaped benchmark and not an assistant: it does not show that Jupiter can answer a question nobody has asked it before.
no probe could be asked for conversation

skills.note: Per-skill recall on a fixed reserved probe set drawn from the corpus. Each probe asks a question taken from one sentence and requires the distinctive terms of the sentence that follows it, so this measures whether what was learned can be recalled in the form it was learned in. That is weaker than answering an arbitrary question and is not a claim of capability.

programming.note: Programming knowledge held as structure rather than as memorized text. Python is read with the standard library's own parser; other languages are read with declared heuristic patterns. Nothing here executes code or proves a programme correct.

register.note: Registers are measured with stated markers and thresholds, not understood. This does not generate language and does not claim to understand it. A document matching nothing is left unknown rather than forced into the nearest class.

external.note: Files, documentation and the knowledge store are read directly; an MCP agent is spoken to over HTTP. APIs and search systems are not implemented and need a dependency or a network policy. Nothing here becomes internal knowledge without passing the retention test, and even then it is filed for the acceptance gate rather than written into the knowledge layer.

holdout_loss.note: mean of the oldest 25 measurements (6.3336) against the newest 25 (6.6324). A change smaller than the typical step between cycles (41.22%) is reported as flat rather than as movement.

regression_loss.note: mean of the oldest 25 measurements (6.4577) against the newest 25 (6.6730). A change smaller than the typical step between cycles (0.59%) is reported as flat rather than as movement.

holdout_accuracy.note: only 0 measurement(s); a direction needs at least 4

cycles_accepted.note: mean of the oldest 25 measurements (0.2800) against the newest 25 (0.0000). A change smaller than the typical step between cycles (28.72%) is reported as flat rather than as movement.

trends.note: holdout_loss and regression_loss are lower-is-better and holdout_accuracy is higher-is-better; each is judged against the noise floor derived from its own series. FLAT means no direction the data supports, not an absence of measurement.
